content: Matti tǝngeˈ elsǝni
Yelsǝni ini mudli nǝ mwani, miˈ laˈti mbatl tǝn Yesu Almasihu mul nalti, bǝˈ shimǝn otl elsǝni geˈ mbadlwakǝn wai.
In mul ulkǝ shimi toh kǝ zinaliya nǝ luˈ lǝgǝl kǝ zokki a mbǝ geˈlu dobga wakǝn u, i mul nǝ bǝ ulǝn nidɗawai u a teteˈ kǝ dlili nǝ keci luˈlǝgǝlu.
In ka ngǝtlin nǝ natl mul laˈti zoˈ luˈlǝgǝlu, iˈ ulǝn tisu, “Kundǝn kǝngu kǝ zoki gawagi,” Amma iˈ ulǝn mul nǝ bǝ ulǝn nidɗawai usu, “dlil tyaka” ko “kuma dǝm atli a kina ɗaka,”
Ase bǝ otl elsǝni geˈ dlomwa kǝn nǝ dambǝtl kǝ ngashti ageˈ dlomwakǝn wai wa?
Kumini yelsǝni ini mudli nǝ mwani: Ase, Lya wolǝn miˈ lǝshi ulǝn kǝ dǝp lǝɓa sǝddǝm miˈ usǝn geˈ laˈti mbadlwaiya? si kǝ miˈ mbiˈ guˈ kǝ Lya nǝ pǝl dlǝlti tǝn ginǝ ɗǝ lyapti uwai ya?
Amma ki mbǝtl miˈgini bǝ ulǝn nisi ɗawai u. Ase, miˈusǝni ɗǝ mbitl kini waiwa? siɗǝ dǝtl kin twakina ɗǝ miˈpǝtl shilǝn waiwa?
Si ɗǝ dlǝb shilǝn kǝ kabbi tǝn shin mul naltu nǝ ɗǝ mbekkin nǝ nali uwai wa?
In ka shindǝlǝn ga tǝn kushti kǝ guˈ kǝ Lya u gunǝ geˈ shilǝn kǝ Lya kǝ laci u ɗǝ ussu, “lyam else dǝm twagi kǝnǝ gawagi,” ka pǝlin kǝ zokki i.
Amma in ka pǝlǝn lyab ga geˈ dlomwakǝn u, ka pǝlǝn bezǝn lǝɓa u ngu, tǝn kushti kǝ Musa ka dǝmni miˈ cetl zhili.
Amma mus mul nǝ ɗǝ katliˈ zhil kǝ Musa u, amma it cel gudǝl nǝmu, to mus ta cel zhilu ɓalu.
To ti u nǝˈ usu, “Bǝ pǝl kontwai u” Ti usu ɗaɗa nu, “Bǝ tlo mbalǝn wai.” To, in kapǝl kontwai u, amma iˈ tlo mbalǝn u, to, ka dǝm mul cetl zhilu ɓalu.
Gaki nǝgu, shilǝn wakǝn nǝ kyautǝn wakǝn tǝ dǝm kǝ miˈ ginǝ nǝn pǝlissi shilǝn kǝ zhil kǝ mbiˈ ga.
Amma gas pǝtl shilǝn Lya kǝn zǝˈ gontwai maˈmulnǝ bǝ ɗa zǝˈ gontwai u. Amma zǝˈ gonti nǝn ɗǝ tleˈ ga kǝ zǝˈ ɓatlti.
Laˈti mbadli Bǝ nǝ Kyautǝn kǝn wai u Use Kǝni
Kini yelsǝni ini, ya kǝ mbuntwasi tǝ yakǝn mbalǝn usu laˈti mbatl nidɗa, bǝ kyautǝn was ɗawai u? anya, laˈti mbadlwasu nǝn pekkǝtl ti wa?
Cibǝlti, in yelsǝni mudli ko mwani, si dǝmti bǝ lulut nisi ɗawai u, hu anǝmi bǝ ulkǝ ɗami ɗa kǝpsiwai.
In gon wakǝn a ulsisu,“To, mbǝkǝcin swaca, tǝ Lya bǝlkin ulkǝ ɗami nǝ ulkǝ tle, nǝ ulkǝ laki” Bǝka bǝlǝnsi ulǝnwai u, mbuntwas nuna?
Nǝgu ɗa laˈti mbadli nǝm nǝ gwasi, bǝnǝ kyautǝn waswai u mǝcini.
Amma mulǝn nǝn ussu“ ai, kiɓo laˈti mbatl niˈ ɗa, ami ne ɓo sai kyautǝn.” To, mboki toh tǝn laˈti mbadlwagu, bǝ nǝ kyautǝn wai u, ami ne a mbokiˈ toh tǝn kyautǝn, yenti kǝ dwaɗǝn kǝ laˈti mbadli.
Ka ndǝgi Lya ɓo nǝm kǝma? A mbuni! to miˈgatl ma sa laˈmbatl nǝti i, amma hal si nepti kǝ dli nǝ ɓanti.
Ki mul lǝshi maˈ ulǝn! ko kǝnɗǝ lyamti hal nǝguni kiˈmani laˈti mbadli bǝ nǝ kyautǝn kǝn wai u, use kǝma?
Cin u nǝ bwasi nǝn Ablahim taˈ yakuwas Ishiyaku tǝn lu kyetl ulnǝ ɗǝ mbilliˈ Lya u, ashe gaki kyautǝn waskǝn manti ti mul zoˈ mbatl kǝn waiya?
Ka yeni laˈti mbadlwas ɗǝ lǝˈ neˈ kyautǝn wasi, kuma laˈti mbadwas a njikǝn tuˈ maˈ kyautǝn wasi.
I njikǝn shilǝn kǝ Lya nǝ usu,“Iblahim a laˈmbatl nǝ Lya i, laˈti mbadlwasu i ɓildli mbatl kǝ zokini maˈti,” I mbekki yelǝn ki Lya.
To ka yenini, Lya ɗǝ pekkǝtl yakǝn mbalǝn gaki kyautǝn wasi, bǝ gaki laˈti mbadlwas nǝmwai.
Gaki nǝgu Lahab mul pǝn neˈ mwani mbi peˈti gaki kyautǝn wa swaya? nǝn nje miˈshinkǝn i u, ippekkǝlsi tuˈtǝn shitu won.
Kǝnǝ kan unǝ dli ɗa bǝ lu shuˈti nidɗa wai u hwunini, nǝguma laˈti mbadli bǝnǝ kyautǝn wai u hwunini.
